summary: Tukaram Ramchandra Laddu worked in Indology and linguistics. He studied at Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg until 1912 and held a post at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, attested in 1920.
Tulku Hungkar Dorje studied under Penor Rinpoche and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.

Tulku Sherdor is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Vassar College, Naropa University, and the University of Virginia, learning under Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Ted Norton, and Jeffrey Hopkins.

Tulku Thondup was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Dodrupchen Monastery under Kyala Khenpo, Khenpo Chemchok, and Dodrupchen Rinpoche. He was a visiting scholar at Harvard University.

Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure who studied under Samten Gyatso, Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Karsé Kongtrul, and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje. He founded Tergar Osel Ling Monastery.
Tuomo Pekkanen is a scholar of linguistics and history and archaeology. He studied under Pentti Aalto and held a post at the University of Jyväskylä from around 1974 to 2000.

Turrell V. Wylie worked in Tibetology, linguistics, and Sinology, completing two B.A. degrees at the University of Washington, where he later became Professor. He also studied under Giuseppe Tucci and Dezhung Rinpoche Kunga Tenpai Nyima.
Tutob Chökyi Wangchuk studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, and Trulshik Rinpoche.
Tyler Dewar specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Nitartha Institute and under traditional teachers Tashi Wangchuk, Lama Tenpa Gyaltsen, and Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche.
Tyler M. Richard works in Indology and linguistics. He held a post in South Asian Studies at Harvard University and is attested as a faculty member at the University of Texas at Austin in 2026.

Tzungkuen Wen specializes in Buddhist studies, earning a PhD from the University of Queensland under Primož Pecenko, Tamara Ditrich, and Chris Kang. He lectured at Fuyan Buddhist Institute and joined Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Studies.
U-tain Wongsathit works in Indology and linguistics. He earned a Ph.D. in Sanskrit from Savitribai Phule Pune University in 2010 and held a Ph.D. in Sanskrit post at Silpakorn University in 2003.

U. Ghimire specializes in Indology and philosophy, earning a PhD from Nepal Sanskrit University. Ghimire also earned degrees in public health and worked for Chitwan Hospital, Rambadevi College, Global Health Alliance Nepal, and the Government of Nepal.
U. V. Swaminatha Iyer was an Indologist. He held posts at Pachaiyappa's College from circa 1903 to 1919 and at Annamalai University from circa 1935 to 1940.

Linguist Udaya Narayana Singh studied at the University of Calcutta and the University of Delhi. He held posts at MS University of Baroda, VNSGU, Delhi, Hyderabad, CIIL as Director, Visva-Bharati, and Amity University, Gurugram.

Udo Posch specialized in Tibetology and linguistics, completing his Ph.D. at the University of Vienna under Robert Bleichsteiner and Herbert W. Duda. He held posts at the University of Graz and the University of Washington.
Ugyen Pelgen works in Tibetology and history and archaeology. He earned a master's degree from Aligarh Muslim University and served as a lecturer of history at Sherubtse College.

Ujjwal Kumar specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology, earning a PhD from Savitribai Phule Pune University. Kumar served as an assistant professor at Pune University from 2006 to 2016 and became a professor at the University of Calcutta in 2016.

Ulrich Mammitzsch worked in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and Japanology. He earned degrees from Hamburg, Southern Illinois, and Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, later serving as director of East Asian Studies at Western Washington University in 1971.

Ulrich Pagel works in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. He studied under Tadeusz Skorupski, Philip Denwood, and Renate Söhnen-Thieme, and was appointed Seiyi Kiriyama Professor in Buddhist Studies at SOAS University of London in 1999.
